states.name: populated
states.description: 10 month cards, September of the selected school year through June of the next — each a plain element (not a nested custom element) inside app-calendario-view's single Shadow DOM, per CLAUDE.md's no-nested-Shadow-DOM rule. Each card's own elementId is data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>" (e.g. calendario-month-2026-09); each day cell inside it is data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>-day-<DD>" (e.g. calendario-month-2026-09-day-05) — this dynamic per-day naming is a documented pattern, not enumerated as individual static elementIds here, mirroring how key-date-settings-view.ts's row ids are generated per data row rather than declared statically.
visual_cues: days spanning >30-day ranges show color only on their start and end day, not every day in between
days with more than one active category split their background into color stripes

screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-calendario-view), reachable from the dashboard's existing calendar-card (src/frontend/src/dashboard-view.ts:22, route /calendario already wired, screen not yet implemented). Read-only — no CRUD from this screen. Renders exclusively from calendario_modulo, a snapshot table populated as a side effect of Año académico's 'Guardar selección' flow (see views/calendario/description_calendario.md) — never reads key_dates directly. Own single-use nav bar (not renderSettingsNav, which is specific to the four Configuración screens), same visual pattern (classesFor('card'), heading far left, link far right). The three filters cascade left to right: school year (simulated carousel, arrows, no real <select>) -> cycle -> módulo, each derived client-side from GET /api/academic-years/:id/modules the same way academic-year-settings-view.ts already derives training-cycle-table's distinct cycles.
